commit.message:
feat: add support for the AWS_EXTERNAL_URI deployments' setting

Setting a value for the AWS_EXTERNAL_URI env variable in the deployments
service, it is possible to use an external URL for the S3 storage when
generating presigned download URLs and an internal URL for all the other
API calls (e.g., uploading of artifacts).

commit.message:
Allow "nodeSelector" option on all deployments

Allow to select the node via helm values. This is necessary in cases,
where the default cluster is not based on x86_64 architecture.
The user needs the option to still force to use x86_64.
